assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one transparent cutout illustration for level 1 of a vocabulary learning statistics banner. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: approved blue mountain illustration. Match its crisp bold geometric faceted shapes, restrained soft internal tonal shading, polished Duolingo/Kurzgesagt educational appearance, vivid simple silhouette. Subject: A large seed splitting open, one tiny fresh coral-red shoot emerging with two folded cream leaves. A small simple deep burgundy soil mound anchors the seed. This is stage1: learning begins. Communicate lively learning growth, do not draw a chart or data graphic. Background banner color will be coral #ff6b6b; ensure strong contrast on that color with ivory and deep plum details. Use the stage color prominently in the actual subject. Compact whole silhouette visible and centered, occupies 80% width and 85% height of a wide3:2canvas. Actual transparent background including all gaps. No rectangular background, no scenery, no pot, no ground oval, no text, no eyes, no mascot, no chart, no arrows, no ring, no decorative confetti. One simple recognizable growth emblem, readable at100px. Avoid detailed veins, textures, thin lines, glossy plastic and extruded 3D; use flat colored facets like the mountain reference.
